tasks.title: Increase the hardcoded sequential worker watchdog timeout in harness/autowork_daemon.py
acceptance_criteria: harness/autowork_daemon.py checks watchdog_timeout based on configuration, with a minimum fallback of 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
No other autowork daemon features are altered.
An auto_commit ledger row is emitted for WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_INCREASE.
tasks.verification_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import harness.autowork_daemon as ad; import inspect; src = inspect.getsource(ad._iteration); assert 'synthesis' in src and 'timeout_seconds' in src, 'watchdog timeout must read from synthesis config'; print('WATCHDOG TIMEOUT INCREASE OK')"

spec.objective: Increase the hardcoded sequential worker watchdog timeout in harness/autowork_daemon.py to 1800s or config-driven values to prevent premature timeout of the full acceptance test suite.
functional_requirements: In harness/autowork_daemon.py, modify the hardcoded 900-second watchdog limit to check cfg.get('synthesis', {}).get('timeout_seconds', 900) plus a 300-second buffer, capped at a minimum of 1800 seconds.
non_goals: Do NOT modify any file other than harness/autowork_daemon.py.
Do not write integration tests for this configuration watchdog increase.
spec.implementation_notes: Modify the watchdog check inside _iteration function of harness/autowork_daemon.py and write the modified file to {OUTBOX_PATH}/submission.py.
